data.completion_memo: Implemented opt-in bounded detailed capture and rotating machine-local diagnostics exactly at the local-store boundary. The shared invocation RedactionSet applies before queues or bytes, rejects credential-bearing fields, malformed structured data, binary/NUL payloads, and residual secrets, and records immutable policy identity without exposing secret values. Capture has absolute per-capture/chunk/count/global caps, bounded compression, atomic manifests, physical-quota accounting across every state, writer/recovery exclusion, safe path validation, expiry/corruption tombstones, and exact unavailable states. Diagnostics use allowlisted structured records with code-derived messages, bounded queue/segments/manifest/tombstones, crash-safe rotation/reconciliation, lifetime writer locking, deterministic flush/shutdown fences, and age/byte retention. The full local-store package passed 74/74 tests; Adashi QA job 10 run 28 passed.
data.description: Implement opt-in bounded detailed protocol/stream capture and rotating machine-local process/storage/IPC/health logs. Apply the invocation redaction set before persistence, keep capture independent from semantic history, enforce quotas and retention, and expose exact unavailable/expired states for evidence queries.
data.title: M10.1 — Implement bounded debug capture and redacted diagnostics
